title: Manual drag-destination normalization can be skipped for destination-only tools
reasoning: normalize_manual_coordinates returns immediately when the resolved tool does not support source grounding, so it never reaches normalize_manual_drag_destination_coordinates. Because drag destination grounding is checked by supports_drag_destination_grounding in its own helper, a destination-grounded tool that does not also support source grounding will leave drag_to_x/drag_to_y in screenshot space and omit drag_destination_coordinate_contract metadata.
recommendation: Do not make manual drag-destination normalization depend on supports_source_grounding. Normalize the source coordinates only when source grounding is supported, then independently normalize drag destination coordinates when drag destination grounding is supported.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover coordinate contracts, image dimension parsing, and resolve_coordinates service selection; none cover normalize_manual_coordinates or drag destination normalization.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a backend test for normalize_manual_coordinates with a resolved drag tool that supports drag destination grounding but not source grounding, asserting drag_to_x/drag_to_y are normalized and metadata is attached.
minimumFixScope: preparation_helper.py plus a focused manual drag-destination regression test.
